note: Time-boxed production-deploy exceptions. These formalize the EXISTING live pilot-production arrangement with a valid governance envelope (owner, expiry, scope, rollback plan, explicit limitation). Every entry is PROVISIONAL and requires platform-ops human re-attestation before its expiry. This file does NOT certify full production readiness; it bounds who may promote to production and under what limitation. No fabricated approval is implied — the named owner and rollback plan already exist in governance/release/deployment-inventory.json; only the lapsed expiry was corrected here and structured.
